answer: Reconciling an agent's on-chain hot-wallet inflows against cold-wallet reserve ledgers, like tracing every drop feeding an ocean, lets a registrar require each identity to prove a real, auditable capital balance. That crystal-clear reserve attestation is costly to fake, since a sybil must lock genuine funds per identity rather than mint free keys. The limit: a rising tide of borrowed capital can still spoof reserves temporarily, so proofs must be continuous, not one-off.
